verdict.rationale: Sierra's voice product documents multi-language support (55-59+ languages, 60+ locales) via Voice Personas, and knowledge base content is described as manageable in Agent Studio, implying grounding could be translated/adapted, but there's no explicit evidence that the agent can auto-translate or serve a knowledge base authored only in English into other languages for chat/text channels. missing for 10: explicit documentation of multilingual chat/text support (not just voice), confirmation that English-only KB content is automatically translated/localized for non-English conversations, and independent/hands-on verification of multilingual quality.
